releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Opening a thread uses the same booking form as New booking, stacked beside the email
- Import details fills the form for review and does not save until you choose Save inquiry or Save booking
- A linked booking or inquiry is shown at the top, and saving edits that record instead of creating another
- A small Replied mark appears when the conversation has an outgoing reply, including replies sent from another mail client on the same account
- Needs reply stays separate and still shows when a newer guest message arrives
- Labels are quieter: Availability, Form received, Booking number or Inquiry, and Guest linked
- Stage and quick replies sit in a compact strip, and the reply box stays closed until you choose Reply
- The thread reads more like an email: sender and time on each message, outgoing mail lightly marked, and quoted history can be shown when needed

## Settings
- Settings are grouped into clearer sections, including a system overview
- Backup history is easier to review
